identity_resolution.receipt_input: Use the exact publication receipt linked by this packet's README or the root publication manifest. The publisher supplies it after the commit succeeds.

fallback_locator.scope: this packet and its publication subdirectory only
fallback_locator.ambiguous_or_missing: STOP and report unresolved publication identity; never choose newest by filename alone.

required_checks: Receipt identifies cosmosapjw-quantum/rei_bianchi and this packet path.
Read the provider-returned actual commit SHA and tree SHA or exact committed paths.
Resolve native files and evidence at that commit; compare source hashes against evidence/FINAL_INTEGRATION.json.
A branch head, intake SHA or proposed future SHA cannot substitute for publication identity.
identity_resolution.reason_null: Intentionally resolved at consumption time from successful publication, not guessed before publication.

next_task_selection.already_done: Do not rerun FLRW01 or FLRW02 merely to rediscover PASS.
next_task_selection.production_integration: Select FLRW03-INTEGRATE-BOUNDED only after its two specification prerequisites pass.
next_task_selection.physical_or_geometry_admission: Select FLRW03-ADMISSION only after all DAG prerequisites and inherited gates are evidenced.

claim_rules: x is a local fraction; X_V is its volume average; X_M is mass weighted; Q_V needs phase geometry.
E3 actually executed a collisionless source-free power-law photon history; the theory's coupled grey Case-A proposal is not executed evidence.
A supplied edge spectrum closes the diagnostic ledger but is not a physical spectral reconstruction certificate.
CaseA primary-only and CaseB local OTS are separate explicit owners; no CaseA override and no ad hoc QSS.
Final evidence/FINAL_INTEGRATION.json supersedes the pre-hardening full-suite snapshot in coding/NATIVE_IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.json only for the final verification it records.

run_policy.allowed_after_relevant_code_change: One targeted changed-path check and one bounded independent reference only when needed to resolve the specific new risk; honor existing required gates.

guards: No heavy runs, parameter sweeps, HPC, new atomic calculations, full HyRec/CosmoRec runs, or repeated completed suites without a concrete new failure.
Preserve REI-F00/F01/F02/F03 receipts, old failed [160,161] interval and tick160 evidence; never relabel them PASS.
Keep original atomic, REC PB02/PB03, E1C and He extensions in their existing lanes; activate only for an explicit domain requirement.
Do not overwrite live CODEX_SYNC or existing REI-F04 task meaning. Resolve current branch and receipt before edits.
stop_if: Native or experiment hashes mismatch the final receipt.
A required spectrum, temperature, geometry or production error budget is unspecified.
